content:
alex: Heads up, opened a docs PR to align voice/tone and product names across docs. TL;DR: canonical product names, voice rules, glossary additions, and SDK snippet syncing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4862 

alex: Proposed highlights:
- Use "Redwood Inference" on first public mention, shorthand "Redwood" only in internal docs.
- Product names: Title Case and capitalized (Redwood API, Redwood Dedicated, Redwood Private, Redwood Console, Redwood Optimize).
- Voice: developer-first, concise. Quickstarts use 2nd-person ("you"); platform explanations use "we".
- Writing rules: present tense; imperative for steps; avoid marketing adjectives in how-to guides.
- Glossary: add entries for Dedicated, Private, Hosted, KV cache, quantization profiles.
- Add tiny error-handling examples in SDK snippets (python + javascript).

maya: +1 on canonical names. small ask: for external pages (marketing/customer docs) always use "Redwood Inference" (no shorthand). Internal docs (internal/*) can use "Redwood". Keeps copy consistent and legal-friendly. :memo:

ryan: Agree re: voice. Also two chores:
- Sync snippets with SDK repo so examples don't rot (see https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/123).
- Include minimal retry/backoff pattern in python/js examples, e.g. exponential backoff + idempotency note.

alex: good call on the retries. I'll add a tiny snippet. Example mockup:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
try:
    resp = client.generate('summarize: ...')
except TransientError:
    # exponential backoff, small jitter
    time.sleep(backoff)
    retry
```
and mirror in JS.

sasha: Glossary suggestion: use full product name followed by parenthetical shortname, e.g. "Redwood Dedicated (Dedicated capacity)". Also make glossary terms lowercase in body but Title Case for product names.

jordan: Small localization note: for EU-facing docs we need to ensure product names are unchanged but add a sentence about deployment regions (e.g., "Available in EU regions"). I'll drop a sentence in the Dedicated/Private pages.

maya: Styling nit: add a small section in the style guide for headings and H1/H2 usage. Quickstarts should be <600 words, with a single H1, H2 for steps.

alex: action items from this thread:
- alex: update PR with SDK snippets and retry examples (ETA today).
- ryan: link SDK repo PR or branch for snippet sync.
- sasha: draft the glossary entries and sample copy.
- maya: add external/internal naming rule text to style guide.
- jordan: add region blurb for EU customers.

docs-bot: [auto] Added label docs/style-guidelines to PR #4862.

maya: pinging @devex to verify sample copy matches our examples library.

ryan: LGTM for approach. leaving code review to alex once updated. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks all, I'll push updates and tag reviewers. If anyone wants to pair on the SDK snippet sync, ping me here.

jordan: +1, will review the region blurb after you push.

sasha: will send glossary PR by EOD.

alex: wrapping up here — marking this thread resolved for now, feel free to re-open if more edits. :white_check_mark:
